old: Isaiah 14:12 — *How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!* The prophet's son-of-the-morning is the very bright one whom Elohim says He deprived of his bright nature so that he became dark.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 13:3 — *I deprived him of that bright nature, and he became dark.* Isaiah's son of the morning is the bright one who lost his light when he broke the commandment.

old: Matthew 6:13 — *And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.* The deliver-us-from-evil and the kingdom-doxology Adam prays in 1 Adam and Eve 23:9 stand word for word in the Saviour's prayer.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 23:9 — *lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil thing; for Thine is the kingdom.* Adam's prayer asks for deliverance and confesses the kingdom as Elohim's, as Matthew 6:13 does.

old: Hebrews 9:22 — *And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.* That Adam could only sue for forgiveness through blood in 1-adam-eve 24:5 is the law Hebrews states — no remission without shed blood, the necessity that drives the whole apparatus to the cross.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 24:5 — *so also will I make My blood forgiveness of sins, and erase transgressions in it.* What Adam sought through blood, the Word promises to supply with His own, as Hebrews 9:22 says no remission comes without it.

old: Hebrews 6:15 — *And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.* Adam's calling-of-the-soul to bear long until the covenant (1 Adam & Eve 26:11) is the patient endurance by which the fathers obtained the promise.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 26:11 — *bear long and calm your soul while you live night and day; until the fulfillment of the days.* Adam is told to wait out the days until the covenant, and Abraham obtained the promise by patient endurance.

old: Romans 5:12 — *Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:* Adam's wonder that he was not struck dead at once (34:11) is the same death-by-one-man Sha'ul traces from this transgression.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 34:11 — *if You had punished me as You said, with death, I should have died that very moment.* Adam's wonder that death did not strike at once is the death by one man that Paul traces in Romans 5:12.

old: Jubilees 3:5 — *And Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon him, and he slept, and He took for the woman one rib from amongst his ribs, and this rib was the origin of the woman from amongst his ribs, and He built up the flesh in its stead, and built the woman.* The restored Jubilees keeps the same rib-drawn-in-sleep that Adam rehearses in 34:14.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 34:14 — *Then You drew a rib out of my side, and created it after my own likeness and image.* Adam tells of the rib and the sleep from his own side, and Jubilees 3:5 tells the same from Yahuah's.

old: Jubilees 4:30 — *And he lacked seventy years of one thousand years; for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens and therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: “On the day that you eat thereof you will die.” For this reason he did not complete the years of this day; for he died during it.* The same day-as-a-thousand-years testimony of the heavens stands behind the 5500-year promise of 1-adam-eve 38:2.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 38:2 — *I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled.* The wait given to Adam is counted in the days of a thousand years that Jubilees 4:30 describes.

old: 2 Peter 3:8 — *But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with Yahuah (Lord) as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.* The 5500-year count of 1-adam-eve 38:2 is reckoned by this day-for-a-thousand-years measure pointing to the Saviour's day.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 38:2 — *only when the 5500 years are fulfilled.* The span set before Adam is measured on the scale Peter names, a day with Yahuah being a thousand years.

old: Revelation 22:14 — *Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.* The eating-and-living-forever pledged to Adam's righteous descendants in 1-adam-eve 38:2 belongs to those who keep the commandments.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 38:2 — *you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.* The tree promised to Adam's righteous descendants is the tree open to those who do His commandments in Revelation 22:14.

old: John 7:38 — *He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.* The blood-as-living-water given to all Adam's seed who believe in 1 Adam & Eve 42:8 is exactly the rivers promised to the believer.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 42:8 — *My blood shall be the Water of Life to you at that time.* The Water of Life promised to Adam's believing descendants is the rivers of living water Yahusha gives in John 7:38.

old: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* Adam's praying for forgiveness in 1 Adam and Eve 47:6 is the first keeping of this same calling-on-the-Name that runs down the holy seed-line.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 47:6 — *they stood and prayed Elohim (God) to forgive them their sins.* Adam and Eve's prayer for forgiveness is the same calling on the Name that Genesis 4:26 records in Enos's day.

old: 1 Corinthians 15:4 — *And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:* The buried-and-third-day-risen gospel Paul calls first of all is the very word spoken to Adam under the rock, rising on the third day according to the scriptures written from the beginning.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 49:9 — *on the third day I shall rise again, and it shall be salvation to you, O Adam.* The third day rising spoken to Adam is the gospel Paul gives in 1 Corinthians 15:4.

old: Exodus 34:28 — *And he was there with Yahuah (LORD) forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.* Adam's neither-eat-nor-drink forty days mirrors Moses on the mount (1 Adam and Eve 71:6).
new: 1 Adam and Eve 71:6 — *He neither ate nor drank until he dropped down on the ground from hunger and thirst.* Adam's forty days without food or drink in prayer matches Moses' forty days before Yahuah in Exodus 34:28.

old: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* Adam's offering for his newborns at 1-adam-eve 74:9 belongs to the same calling-on-the-Name that marks the covenant line from the first.
new: 1 Adam and Eve 74:9 — *We will make an offering and offer it up in behalf of the children.* Adam and Eve's offering for their children belongs to the calling on Yahuah's name that Genesis 4:26 records.

old: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* Messiah names the same liar-from-the-beginning whom Yahuah here orders to show himself plainly to Adam.
new: 2 Adam and Eve 4:1 — *Elohim (God) ordered Satan to show himself to Adam plainly, in his own hideous form.* Satan shown to Adam in his own form is the murderer and liar from the beginning whom Yahusha names in John 8:44.

old: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* The righteousness Enos commands Cainan to establish in 2 Adam and Eve 14:3 is the calling-on-the-Name that began in Enos’s own generation.
new: 2 Adam and Eve 14:3 — *stand ministering before the body of our father Adam, all the days of thy life.* Enos's charge to Cainan to keep a righteous people is the calling on the Name that Genesis 4:26 places in Enos's days.

old: Apocalypse of Abraham 18:4 — *of a lion, of a man, of an ox, of an eagle... and each had six wings* the four faces and six wings together, exactly John's six-winged eye-filled beasts (Revelation 4:8).
new: Apocalypse of Abraham 18:4 — *of a lion, of a man, of an ox, of an eagle: four heads were upon their bodies.* Abraham's four faced creatures with six wings are the beasts around the throne in Revelation 4:8.

old: Exodus 3:2 — *And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.* The voice that speaks to Abraham from the midst of the fire is the same fire-that-does-not-consume that called Moses at Horeb (Apocalypse of Abraham 19:1).
new: Apocalypse of Abraham 19:1 — *a voice came to me out of the midst of the fire, saying.* The voice calling Abraham out of the fire is the fire from which Moses was called at the bush in Exodus 3:2.

old: Psalm 104:4 — *Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire.* Abraham's angels of pure spirit without bodies, serving the fiery angels, are the very spirits-and-flaming-ministers of the Psalm (Apocalypse of Abraham 19:6).
new: Apocalypse of Abraham 19:6 — *angels, of pure spirit, without bodies, who carried out the commands of the fiery angels.* The bodiless spirits serving fiery angels are the spirits and flaming ministers of Psalm 104:4.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 1:3 — *Beliar was wroth with Hizkiyah (Hezekiah) because of his vision... by him the going forth of the Beloved from the seventh heaven had been made known.* Beliar's adversarial pattern toward the prophetic revelation of the Beloved's descent; Matt 4:10's *Get thee hence, Satan* dismisses the same figure.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 3:13 — *the going forth of the Beloved from the seventh heaven had been made known.* The Beloved whose descent enraged Beliar sends Satan away with the Torah's own word.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 4:2 — *Beliar will descend, the great angel, the king of this world, which he has ruled ever since it came into being.* The Hebrew library names Beliar as the king-of-this-world; Matt 4:8-9's offer of all the kingdoms is the same figure offering what he currently administers.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 4:2 — *Beliar the great ruler, the king of this world, will descend, who hath ruled it since it came into being.* The Ascension of Isaiah names the one who has ruled this world from the beginning, and the devil offers Yahusha (Jesus) what he holds.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 4:3 — *will persecute the plant which the Twelve Apostles of the Beloved have planted. Of the Twelve one will be delivered into his hands.* Two architecture-elements named in advance at the wisdom-stream level: persecution-of-the-plant + inner-circle-betrayal. The Matt 10:4 Yahudah (Judah) Iscariot listing-with-betrayal-note and Matt 10:16-22 persecution-disclosure walk the same architecture at the commissioning-discourse register.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 4:3 — *Of the Twelve one will be delivered into his hands.* The persecution of the plant and the loss of one of the Twelve were told in advance, and Matthew's list ends on the one who betrayed.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 4:9 — *he will speak as the Beloved and will say: I am Elohim (God), and before me there was none.* Beliar's standing worship-grab; Matt 4:9's *fall down and worship me* enacts the same.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 4:9 — *those who shall have been associated together in order to receive the Beloved, he will turn aside after him.* The ruler who asked the Son for worship turns aside the greater number of those gathered to receive the Beloved.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 9:14 — *the god of that world will stretch forth his hand against the Son, and they will crucify Him on a tree, and will slay Him not knowing who He is.* THE direct external-witness verbal-anchor: the wisdom-stream named the crucify-Him-on-a-tree substance at the prophet-Yeshayahu (Isaiah)-vision-register per Devarim (Deuteronomy) 21:22-23 + Galatians 3:13. The *not knowing who He is* substance in continuity with 1 Corinthians 2:8.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 9:14 — *will stretch forth his hand against the Son, and they will crucify Him on a tree.* The deed is traced to the god of that world, and those who did it did not know who He was.

old: Isaiah 53:2 — *For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.* The descent 'hidden even from the heavens' lands as Isaiah's own no-form-nor-comeliness — the prophet himself foretold the disguised coming.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 9:15 — *His descent, as you will see, will be hidden even from the heavens.* The descent hidden from the heavens matches Isaiah's tender plant with no form or comeliness.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 9:16 — *when He hath plundered the angel of death, He will ascend on the third day.* The descent-to-plunder-the-angel-of-death architecture — the King's voluntary-yielding-up-of-the-ghost at Matt 27:50 walks-into-the-descent per Hosheia (Hosea) 6:2 + 13:14 + 1 Peter 3:18-20 + Hebrews 2:14-15's *that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil.*
new: Ascension of Isaiah 9:16 — *when He hath plundered the angel of death, He will ascend on the third day.* The Son who yielded up the ghost at the cross plunders the angel of death and rises on the third day.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 9:17 — *many of the righteous will ascend with Him, whose spirits do not receive their garments till Yahuah (Lord) Messiah (Christ) ascend and they ascend with Him.* THE direct external-witness verbal-anchor: this IS the operative external-witness verbal-anchor for Matt 27:52-53's *the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose, and came out of the graves after his resurrection.* In continuity with Hebrews 11:39-40's *they without us should not be made perfect* per Red Line #11's first-resurrection-foretaste reading.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 9:17 — *many of the righteous will ascend with Him, whose spirits do not receive their garments.* The righteous who sleep wait for the Messiah's ascension, and Matthew shows the first of them rising.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 11:19 — *they delivered Him to the king, and crucified Him, and He descended to the angel of Sheol.* The burial + descent-into-the-place-of-the-dead architecture — Yoseph (Joseph) of Arimathea's rich-man's-tomb at Matt 27:60 walks-out Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 53:9's *he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death.* The *roused the children of Yashar'el (Israel) against Him* substance read CAREFULLY against Red Line #9 — the adversary-roused-the-leadership-of-the-second-Temple-aristocracy at the historical-pivot, NOT the Yahudah (Jewish)-people-as-a-whole; the framework rejects the inherited-Christian-replacement-theology weaponization.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 11:19 — *they delivered Him to the king, and crucified Him, and He descended to the angel of Sheol.* While the body lay in the sealed tomb, the Beloved went down to the angel of Sheol.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 11:19 — *and after this the adversary envied Him and roused the children of Yashar'el (Israel) against Him, not knowing who He was, and they delivered Him to the king, and crucified Him, and He descended to the angel of Sheol.* The system-not-people architecture per Red Line #9 named explicitly at the wisdom-stream-vision-register: the adversary (Sammael Satan) is the substantial-source; the people are roused-against-Him not-knowing-who-He-was — victims of the deception. The chief-priests' bribery-cover-up at Matt 28:11-15 is the operative-form: the corrupt-leadership-system fabricating the anti-Resurrection-narrative; the *commonly reported among the Yahudim (Jews) until this day* substance names the success-of-the-leadership's-narrative-among-the-people-still-inside-the-system, NOT categorical-anti-Yahudi (Jewish) substance.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 11:19 — *the adversary envied Him and roused the children of Yashar'el (Israel) against Him, not knowing who He was.* The adversary roused the people not knowing who He was, and Matthew shows the leadership answering the truth with a cover story.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 11:20 — *In Jerusalem indeed I saw Him being crucified on a tree.* The prophet-Yeshayahu (Isaiah)-saw-in-vision what the King walks at the historical-pivot per John 12:41's *these things said Esaias (Isaiah), when he saw his glory, and spake of him.* The wisdom-stream and the gospel cohere at the substance.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 11:20 — *In Jerusalem indeed I saw Him being crucified on a tree.* Isaiah is shown the crucifixion ahead of time, in Jerusalem, on a tree.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 11:21 — *and likewise after the third day rise again and remain days.* THE direct external-witness verbal-anchor for the third-day-Resurrection substance — the wisdom-stream-prophetic-substance at the heavenly-vision-register the heavenly-messenger's-announcement at Matt 28:6 (*He is not here: for he is risen, as he said*) operatively-fulfills. The remain-days-substance ties to the forty-days-between-Resurrection-and-Ascension per Acts 1:3.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 11:21 — *after the third day rise again and remain days.* Isaiah is shown the rising after the third day and the days He remained, which the angel at the tomb announces as fulfilled.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 11:22 — *and the angel who conducted me said: "Understand, Isaiah": and I saw when He sent out the Twelve Apostles and ascended.* THE direct external-witness verbal-anchor for the substantial-Great-Commission + Ascension substance — the King-sending-out-the-Twelve-Apostles + the Ascension named in the same breath. The substantial-Twelve walks the substantial-twelve-tribes-restoration-architecture per Matt 19:28 + Revelation 21:14.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 11:22 — *I saw when He sent out the Twelve Apostles and ascended.* The sending of the Twelve and the ascension are seen together, as Matthew's last words to the Twelve are spoken.

old: Revelation 5:12 — *Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.* The praise that increased in volume through the heavens is the heavenly worthy-is-the-Lamb of John's throne-room.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 11:26 — *How did our Lord escape us whilst descending, and we perceived not?* The heavens worship the Beloved who passed through unseen, as they cry Worthy is the Lamb in Revelation.

old: Ascension of Isaiah 11:32 — *and I saw how He ascended into the seventh heaven, and all the righteous and all the angels praised Him. And then I saw Him sit down on the right hand of that Great Glory whose glory I told you that I could not behold.* THE direct external-witness verbal-anchor for the King's-Ascension-to-the-right-hand-of-the-Great-Glory substance — the operative-substance of Psalm 110:1 + Daniel 7:13-14 + the substantial *all power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* at Matt 28:18. The Great-Glory is the Father — the Formless-Source per Red Line #10; the right-hand is the position from-which the King walks the everlasting-dominion. NOT the inherited-Christian three-co-equal-persons substance.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 11:32 — *I saw Him sit down on the right hand of that Great Glory.* The Son sits at the right hand of the Great Glory, the Father, and Matthew has him say that all power is given unto him.

old: 2 Baruch 6:7 (Charles edition seq #3) — *I saw him descend into the Holy of Holies, and take from thence the veil, and the holy ark, and the mercy-seat.* The wisdom-stream's heavenly-register articulation of the angel-from-above acting upon the veil — Matt 27:51's veil-rent-from-the-top-to-the-bottom names the operative-fulfillment of the Father-from-above tearing-the-veil-from-the-heavenly-side per Hebrews 10:19-22.
new: 2 Baruch 6:7 — *I saw him descend into the Holy of Holies, and take from thence the veil, and the holy ark.* The angel who descends and takes the veil in 2 Baruch is the hand from above that tears the veil in Matthew.

old: John 6:35 — *And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.* The descending manna of the Messiah's years finds its substance in the Anointed Himself, the bread of life on whom the saved feed and never hunger.
new: 2 Baruch 29:8 — *the treasury of manna shall again descend from on high.* The manna promised again from on high is the bread of life Yahusha (Jesus) names himself.

old: 2 Baruch 51:1 (Charles edition seq #21) — *those who have been saved by their works, and to whom the law has been now a hope... shall behold the world which is now invisible to them, and they shall behold the time which is now hidden from them.* The wisdom-stream's resurrection-glory architecture — the saints-arising-and-appearing-in-the-holy-city at Matt 27:53 walks-out the historical-pivot-foretaste. Read the *saved by their works* CAREFULLY — NOT the inherited-Reformation-merit-doctrine collapse; works are the fruit-of-the-Spirit-internalized-Torah per Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27 + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:31-34 + James 2:14-26.
new: 2 Baruch 51:7 — *to whom the law has been now a hope, And understanding an expectation, And wisdom a confidence.* Those for whom the law was a hope are promised sight of the invisible world, and Matthew shows the sleeping saints beginning to rise.

old: 2 Baruch 35:1 — *the days come, and it shall be when the time of the age has ripened, and the harvest of its evil and good seeds has come.* The apocalyptic-stream names the harvest of the age explicitly; Matt 9:37's *the harvest truly is plenteous* names the present-tense fulfillment at the King's arrival.
new: 2 Baruch 70:2 — *the harvest of its evil and good seeds has come.* The harvest of the age, evil and good seeds together, is the harvest Yahusha (Jesus) says is already plenteous.

old: 2 Baruch 35:1 (extended) — the same eschatological-harvest-of-the-age verse also anchors Matt 9:38's *pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers.* The Lord-of-the-harvest is the Mighty One the apocalyptic-stream had named; the labourers being prayed-for are about to be commissioned at Matt 10:1.
new: 2 Baruch 70:2 — *the harvest of its evil and good seeds has come.* The prayer Yahusha (Jesus) teaches in Matthew 9:38 asks for workers for this same harvest.

old: Rev 21:4 — *there shall be no more death... for the former things are passed away* — the corruptible consummated and the incorruptible begun, Baruch's near-to-things-which-die-not.
new: 2 Baruch 74:2 — *the consummation of that which is corruptible, And the beginning of that which is not corruptible.* John sees the same passing in Revelation 21:4, where there is no more death because the former things are passed away.

old: 2 Baruch 38:4 — *all we the twelve tribes are bound by one bond, inasmuch as we are born from one father.* The apocalyptic-stream's twelve-tribes-bound-by-one-bond architecture; the scattered-shepherdless multitudes Yahusha (Jesus) sees at Matt 9:36 are the same one-father-born twelve-tribe-body the wisdom-stream had named.
new: 2 Baruch 78:3 — *all we the twelve tribes are bound by one bond, inasmuch as we are born from one father.* The scattered, shepherdless multitudes Yahusha (Jesus) sees in Matthew 9:36 are this one family born from one father.

old: 2 Baruch 38:7 — *with much mercy will gather together again those who were dispersed.* The apocalyptic-stream's explicit gathering-of-the-dispersed-with-much-mercy architecture; the same mercy-substance Hosea 6:6 names at Matt 9:13, now operative as the gathering-architecture of Matt 9:36's scattered-shepherdless multitudes.
new: 2 Baruch 78:7 — *with much mercy will gather together again those who were dispersed.* The compassion Yahusha (Jesus) shows the scattered sheep in Matthew 9:36 is this promised mercy at work.

old: Testaments of the XII / Levi 3:5 (Charles edition seq #14) — *the angel opened to me the gates of heaven, and I saw the holy temple, and upon a throne of glory the Most High.* THE direct verbal-anchor: the gates-of-heaven opened-in-vision are opened-in-operative-form at Matt 27:51 when the King's flesh-veil is torn — the way-to-the-Father opens per Hebrews 10:20's *new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh.*
new: Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 21:1 — *the angel opened to me the gates of heaven, and I saw the holy temple.* The gates opened to Levi are the veil torn from the top at the cross.

old: Testaments of the XII / Levi 4:2 (Charles edition seq #15) — *I have given thee the blessings of the priesthood until I come and sojourn in the midst of Yashar'el (Israel).* The wisdom-stream names the provisional-priestly-mediation-architecture as *until I come and sojourn* — the *I come and sojourn* the King walks-out at the incarnation-and-cross per John 1:14's *the Word was made flesh, and dwelt (tabernacled) among us*; the veil-rent at Matt 27:51 names the architectural-consequence of the *until* being fulfilled.
new: Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 21:2 — *I have given thee the blessings of the priesthood until I come and sojourn in the midst of Yashar'el (Israel).* The until in Levi's blessing is met when the veil is torn in Matthew 27:51 and the one who sojourns has come.

old: Testaments of the XII / Levi 4:17 (Charles edition seq #15) — *some of them shall be high priests, and judges, and scribes; for by their mouth shall the holy place be guarded.* The wisdom-stream names the *holy place guarded by their mouth* substance — the saints-arising at Matt 27:52 walk-out at the historical-foretaste-substance per Red Line #11's first-resurrection-foretaste reading: the forefathers-who-walked-the-covenant-faithfully Yahuah is able to graft-in-again at the first-resurrection.
new: Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 24:17 — *For by their mouth shall the holy place be guarded.* The faithful dead who rise in Matthew 27:52 are the same covenant line Levi's vision speaks of.

old: Testament of Levi 17:2 — *behold, I am clear from your ungodliness and transgression, which ye shall commit in the end of the ages against the Saviour of the world, Messiah (Christ).* THE direct verbal-anchor for the corrupt-high-priesthood-at-the-end-of-the-ages-condemning-the-Saviour-of-the-world-Messiah substance — the substantial-prefiguring of the corrupt-Sanhedrin-Kaiapha (Caiaphas)-aristocracy at Matt 26:31's smitten-shepherd architecture + the broader Sanhedrin-trial at vv.57-68. System-not-people posture holds non-negotiable: the substance walks against the corrupt-leadership, NEVER against the Yahudi (Jewish)-people.
new: Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 26:2 — *I am clear from your ungodliness and transgression, which ye shall commit in the end of the ages.* Levi's warning of ungodly leaders at the end of the ages stands behind the smitten shepherd and scattered flock of Matthew 26:31.

old: Testaments XII Levi (file ch 17, canonical Testament of Levi 16) v.3 — *And ye shall deal lawlessly together with Yashar'el (Israel), so He shall not bear with Jerusalem because of your wickedness; but the veil of the temple shall be rent.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the corrupted-priesthood-substance walking-lawlessly — the substance the King walks-against at Matt 23:13 (the first-woe — *ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men*). The veil-of-the-temple-rent substance walks-toward the historical-fulfillment at Matt 27:51.
new: Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 26:3 — *ye shall deal lawlessly together with Yashar'el (Israel), so He shall not bear with Jerusalem because of your wickedness.* Levi's lawless leaders who hold the door are the ones Yahusha (Jesus) faces in the first woe of Matthew 23:13.

old: Testament of Levi 17:3 — *the veil of the temple shall be rent, so as not to cover your shame. And ye shall be scattered as captives among the Gentiles.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the veil-of-the-temple-shall-be-rent substance + the corrupt-priesthood-scattered-as-captives substance. The high-priest-Kaiapha (Caiaphas) at Matt 26:65 violates Leviticus 10:6 + 21:10 (the high-priest is-NOT-to-rend-his-clothes) — the substantial-corrupt-high-priesthood-substance the Test. Levi-substance had named-the-substance-for. The Matthew 27:51 substance walks-into-substantively-the-substantial-end-of-the-Second-Temple-corrupt-priestly-aristocracy-substance + direct-access through the King-as-the-High-Priest (Hebrews 4:14-16, 10:19-22).

old: Revelation 22:5 — *And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.* The "neither night, nor darkness, but great light" of 2 Enoch 65:6 is John's city where there is no night and Yahuah Himself is the light.
new: Revelation 22:5 — *And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.* The "nor night, nor darkness, but great light" of 2 Enoch 65:6 is John's city where there is no night and Yahuah Himself is the light.

old: Psalms 139:8 — *If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.* The "if you look to heaven, the Lord is there... and all the under-earth, the Lord is there" of 2 Enoch 66:5 is David's confession that Yahuah fills heaven and the depth alike.
new: Psalms 139:8 — *If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.* The "If you look to heaven, Yahuah Shammah (the Lord is there)... and all the under-earth, Yahuah Shammah (the Lord is there)" of 2 Enoch 66:5 is David's confession that Yahuah fills heaven and the depth alike.

old: Habakkuk 2:3 — *For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come* — the wrath that 'in its own season shall awake,' the appointed delay Baruch describes.
new: Habakkuk 2:3 — *For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come* — the wrath that 'in its own season shall the (divine) wrath awake' the appointed delay Baruch describes.

old: Romans 11:33 — *O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of Elohim (God)! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!* — Baruch's 'who will comprehend Thy judgement' in the apostle's very words.
new: Romans 11:33 — *O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of Elohim (God)! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!* — Baruch's 'who, O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, will comprehend Thy judgement' in the apostle's very words.

old: Gen 37:27 — *Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.* — Judah's counsel that Simeon recalls, "Judah my brother sold him to the Ishmaelites."
new: Gen 37:27 — *Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.* — Judah's counsel that Simeon recalls, "Yahudah (Judah) my brother sold him to the Ishmaelites."

old: Prov 14:27 — *The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.* — the very deliverance Simeon found: "deliverance from envy cometh by the fear of God."
new: Prov 14:27 — *The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.* — the very deliverance Simeon found: "deliverance from envy cometh by the fear of Elohim (God)."

old: James 3:16 — *For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.* — envy's fruit, the same root Simeon names that "suffereth him to do no good thing."
new: James 3:16 — *For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.* — envy's fruit, the same root Simeon names that "suffereth him 'neither to eat nor to drink', nor to do any good thing."

old: Zech 6:13 — *and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.* — the division "in Levi and Judah," priest and king at peace, that Simeon names.
new: Zech 6:13 — *and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.* — the division "in Levi and Yahudah (Judah)," priest and king at peace, that Simeon names.

old: Gen 6:11 — *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* — fornication "the mother of all evils," filling the earth with corruption as in Noah's day.
new: Gen 6:11 — *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* — fornication "mother of all evils," filling the earth with corruption as in Noah's day.

old: Gen 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* — the fornication of the Watchers that "bringeth near to Beliar," the root Enoch expounds.
new: Gen 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* — the fornication of the Watchers that "bringing near to Beliar," the root Enoch expounds.

old: Gen 9:26 — *Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.* — "the Mighty One of Israel shall glorify Shem" and Canaan perish, Noah's blessing fulfilled.
new: Gen 9:26 — *Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.* — "the Mighty One of Yashar'el (Israel) shall glorify Shem" and Canaan perish, Noah's blessing fulfilled.

old: Heb 7:25 — *Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto Elohim (God) by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.* — "He shall save all the race of Israel," the salvation arising from the two tribes.
new: Heb 7:25 — *Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto Elohim (God) by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.* — "He shall save all [the Gentiles and] the race of Yashar'el (Israel)," the salvation arising from the two tribes.

old: Isaiah 6:3 — *Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): the whole earth is full of his glory.* The thrones and dominions that 'always offer praise to God' echo the seraphim's unceasing cry.
new: Isaiah 6:3 — *Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): the whole earth is full of his glory.* The thrones and dominions that 'always they offer praise to Elohim (God)' echo the seraphim's unceasing cry.

old: Isaiah 9:2 — *The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light.* Levi lighting 'the light of knowledge in Jacob' and shining 'as the sun to all the seed of Israel' is the great light upon the people.
new: Isaiah 9:2 — *The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light.* Levi lighting 'The light of knowledge shalt thou light up in Jacob' and shining 'as the sun shalt thou be to all the seed of Yashar'el (Israel)' is the great light upon the people.

old: Malachi 3:1 — *Yahuah (Lord), whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple.* 'Until I come and sojourn in the midst of Israel' is the Lord's promised coming to His temple.
new: Malachi 3:1 — *Yahuah (Lord), whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple.* 'until I come and sojourn in the midst of Yashar'el (Israel)' is the Lord's promised coming to His temple.

old: Hebrews 7:12 — *For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.* That Levi's seed is divided 'for a sign of the glory of the Lord who is to come' answers to the changed priesthood Hebrews names.
new: Hebrews 7:12 — *For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.* That Levi's seed is divided 'for a sign of the glory of Yahuah (Lord) who is to come' answers to the changed priesthood Hebrews names.

old: Matthew 6:20 — *But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt.* 'Work righteousness... that ye may have it as a treasure in heaven' is the treasure laid up above.
new: Matthew 6:20 — *But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt.* 'Work righteousness... That ye may have (it) as a treasure in heaven' is the treasure laid up above.

old: Deuteronomy 6:5 — *And thou shalt love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.* 'Fear the Lord your God with your whole heart' is the Shema's command of whole-hearted love.
new: Deuteronomy 6:5 — *And thou shalt love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.* 'Fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the Lord your God) with your whole heart' is the Shema's command of whole-hearted love.

old: Malachi 2:7 — *the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).* The office the priests forsake when 'puffed up because of their priesthood' is the lips that should keep knowledge.
new: Malachi 2:7 — *the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).* The office the priests forsake when 'puffed up because of your priesthood' is the lips that should keep knowledge.

old: Genesis 3:24 — *he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* 'He shall open the gates of paradise, and remove the threatening sword against Adam' undoes the flaming sword that barred Eden.
new: Genesis 3:24 — *he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* 'he shall open the gates of paradise, And shall remove the threatening sword against Adam' undoes the flaming sword that barred Eden.

old: Psalm 110:4 — *Yahuah (LORD) hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).* The new priest 'to whom there shall none succeed for ever' is the priest sworn for ever after Melchizedek.
new: Psalm 110:4 — *Yahuah (LORD) hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).* The new priest Yahuah (the Lord) raises up, to whom all his words are revealed and who judges the earth for a multitude of days, is the priest Yahuah (the LORD) swore in after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek) — a priesthood not from Levi's line and not for a season.

old: Deuteronomy 30:19 — *I call heaven and earth to record this day against you... therefore choose life.* 'The Lord is witness, and His angels are witnesses, and ye are witnesses' is Moses' calling of heaven and earth to record the choice of life.
new: Deuteronomy 30:19 — *I call heaven and earth to record this day against you... therefore choose life.* 'Yahuah (Lord) is witness, and His angels are witnesses, and ye are witnesses' is Moses' calling of heaven and earth to record the choice of life.

old: Deuteronomy 30:15 — *See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil.* 'Choose for yourselves either the light or the darkness, either the law of the Lord or the works of Beliar' is the life-and-death Moses set before Israel.
new: Deuteronomy 30:15 — *See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil.* 'choose, therefore, for yourselves either the light or the darkness, either the law of Yahuah (Lord) or the works of Beliar' is the life-and-death Moses set before Israel.

old: Genesis 38:26 — *And Yahudah (Judah) acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.* Judah's "I came not again near her while I lived" is the same confession Moses sets down.
new: Genesis 38:26 — *And Yahudah (Judah) acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.* Judah's "she privily sent my pledges, and put me to shame" is the same confession Moses sets down.

old: Genesis 49:10 — *The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.* The kingdom "established from me" is the scepter Jacob fixed on Judah.
new: Genesis 49:10 — *The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.* The kingdom "from me shall the kingdom be established" is the scepter Jacob fixed on Judah.

old: Isaiah 45:17 — *But Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved in Yahuah (LORD) with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.* The coming "salvation of Israel" and rest in peace is Isaiah's everlasting salvation.
new: Isaiah 45:17 — *But Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved in Yahuah (LORD) with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.* The coming "salvation of Yashar'el (Israel)" and rest in peace is Isaiah's everlasting salvation.

old: Genesis 49:10 — *The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.* The kingdom held "until the salvation of Israel shall come" is the scepter held until Shiloh comes.
new: Genesis 49:10 — *The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.* The kingdom held "Until the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel) shall come" is the scepter held until Shiloh comes.

old: Isaiah 11:1 — *And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots.* "This Branch of Elohim Most High" is Isaiah's Branch grown from the roots of Jesse.
new: Isaiah 11:1 — *And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots.* "This Branch of Elohim (God) El Elyon (Most High)" is Isaiah's Branch grown from the roots of Jesse.

old: Numbers 24:17 — *...there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.* Judah's "a star shall arise to you from Jacob" is Balaam's very oracle of the Star and Sceptre.
new: Numbers 24:17 — *...there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.* Judah's "shall a star arise to you from Jacob" is Balaam's very oracle of the Star and Sceptre.

old: Genesis 49:10 — *The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.* "To Yahudah He gave the kingdom" is Jacob's own dying word over Judah's sceptre.
new: Genesis 49:10 — *The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.* "to Yahudah (Judah) the kingdom" is Jacob's own dying word over Judah's sceptre.

old: Matthew 22:40 — *On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.* Issachar's "keep the law of God" reduced to love of God and neighbour is the very hinge the Master names.
new: Matthew 22:40 — *On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.* Issachar's "Keep, therefore, my children, the law of Elohim (God)" reduced to love of God and neighbour is the very hinge the Master names.

old: Matthew 5:7 — *Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.* "Have compassion... that Yahuah also may have compassion and mercy upon you" is the Beatitude almost word for word.
new: Matthew 5:7 — *Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.* "Have, therefore, yourselves also, my children, compassion... that Yahuah (Lord) also may have compassion and mercy upon you" is the Beatitude almost word for word.

old: Ezekiel 37:22 — *And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.* Zebulun's "ye shall be divided... and follow two kings" is the very division of the two kingdoms Ezekiel says shall at last be made one.
new: Ezekiel 37:22 — *And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.* Zebulun's "Ye shall be divided in Yashar'el (Israel), And ye shall follow two kings" is the very division of the two kingdoms Ezekiel says shall at last be made one.

old: Genesis 1:31 — *And Elohim (God) saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.* — "God made all things good in their order" echoes the verdict over the whole creation, that it was very good.
new: Genesis 1:31 — *And Elohim (God) saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.* — "Elohim (God) made all things good in their order" echoes the verdict over the whole creation, that it was very good.

old: Psalm 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.* — "change not the law of God" rests on the law that is perfect, the same psalm that begins with the ordered heavens.
new: Psalm 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.* — "change not the law of Elohim (God)" rests on the law that is perfect, the same psalm that begins with the ordered heavens.

old: Deuteronomy 30:3 — *That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath scattered thee.* — "ye shall return and acknowledge the LORD your God; and He shall bring you back into your own land, according to His abundant mercy" is the turning of the captivity and the gathering Moses promised.
new: Deuteronomy 30:3 — *That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath scattered thee.* — "ye shall return and acknowledge Yahuah Elohaychem (the Lord your God); and He shall bring you back into your own land, according to His abundant mercy" is the turning of the captivity and the gathering Moses promised.

old: Psalm 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.* — "be ye wise in Elohim... understanding the order of His commandments" rests on the law that is perfect and makes the simple wise.
new: Psalm 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.* — "Be ye therefore wise in Elohim (God)... understanding the order of His commandments" rests on the law that is perfect and makes the simple wise.

old: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* — "God shall appear, dwelling among men on earth" is fulfilled when the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us — the Father made manifest in the Son He sent.
new: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* — "Elohim (God) shall appear, dwelling among men on earth" is fulfilled when the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us — the only begotten whom the Father sent, the Formed one walking among men.

old: Zechariah 2:10 — *Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith Yahuah (LORD).* — "God shall appear, dwelling among men on earth" is the LORD's own promise to come and dwell in the midst of Zion.
new: Zechariah 2:10 — *Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith Yahuah (LORD).* — "shall Elohim (God) appear [dwelling among men] on earth" is the LORD's own promise to come and dwell in the midst of Zion.

old: Psalms 37:1 — *Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.* Gad's 'be not vexed... be not envious' when another prospers is David's own counsel against envy.
new: Psalms 37:1 — *Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.* Gad's 'do not be vexed... be not envious' when another prospers is David's own counsel against envy.

old: Leviticus 11:6 — *And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.* Asher's "half clean, but in very deed unclean" hare is the very creature Moses names: it answers one mark of cleanness and fails the other, like the double-faced man.
new: Leviticus 11:6 — *And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.* Asher's "half clean, but in very deed are unclean" hare is the very creature Moses names: it answers one mark of cleanness and fails the other, like the double-faced man.

old: Genesis 19:24 — *Then Yahuah (LORD) rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Yahuah (LORD) out of heaven;* Asher's warning, "Become not as Sodom, which knew not the angels of Yahuah (Lord), and perished for ever," recalls the city that rejected the two angels and was destroyed.
new: Genesis 19:24 — *Then Yahuah (LORD) rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Yahuah (LORD) out of heaven;* Asher's warning, "Become not, my children, as Sodom, which knew not the angels of Yahuah (Lord), and perished for ever," recalls the city that rejected the two angels and was destroyed.

old: Genesis 39:2 — *And Yahuah (LORD) was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.* The refrain of the whole testament — "Yahuah loved me... the God of my fathers guarded me" — is Moses' own refrain over Joseph.
new: Genesis 39:2 — *And Yahuah (LORD) was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.* The refrain of the whole testament — "Yahuah (Lord) loved me... the Elohim (God) of my fathers guarded me" — is Moses' own refrain over Joseph.

old: Genesis 39:10 — *And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.* The woman's repeated threatening "How often did she threaten me... and call me back" is Moses' "day by day."
new: Genesis 39:10 — *And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.* The woman's repeated threatening "How often did the Egyptian woman threaten me with death!... and then call me back and threaten me" is Moses' "day by day."

old: Genesis 45:1 — *Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me.* That Joseph here "desired greatly to weep, but restrained myself" is the same overflowing heart Moses records breaking forth before his brethren.
new: Genesis 45:1 — *Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me.* That Joseph here "desired greatly to weep, but I restrained myself" is the same overflowing heart Moses records breaking forth before his brethren.

old: Leviticus 19:18 — *Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* "Love one another, and with long-suffering hide one another's faults" is the royal commandment in plain words.
new: Leviticus 19:18 — *Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* "love one another, and with long-suffering hide 'ye one another's faults'" is the royal commandment in plain words.

old: Deut 30:4 — *from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee.* — the gathering of "all Israel unto the Lord" Benjamin foresees.
new: Deut 30:4 — *from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee.* — the gathering of "all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be gathered unto Yahuah (Lord)" Benjamin foresees.

old: The Father commissioning the Beloved to descend through the heavens — the framework's Formless-and-Formed nature-of-God reading carried in apocalyptic register.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 10:8 — *Go forth and descend through all the heavens, and thou wilt descend to the firmament and that world.* The Father sends the Beloved down through the heavens, and Matthew 1:23 names where the descent ends: *Elohim (God) with us.*

old: Ascension of Isaiah 9:12 — the Beloved's descent in human form. The framework the public naming at Matt 3:17 completes.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 9:12 — *Crowns and thrones of glory they do not receive, till the Beloved will descend.* Heaven announces beforehand the Beloved's coming down in human form, and at the water the voice from heaven says, *This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased* (Matthew 3:17).

old: Ascension of Isaiah 11:32 — the ascent of the Beloved and the seating at the right hand of the Great Glory. The completion of the descent-naming-ascent arc the framework holds.
new: Ascension of Isaiah 11:32 — *And then I saw Him sit down on the right hand of that Great Glory.* The Son whom the voice from heaven names at the water (Matthew 3:17) is seen here with his journey down and back up finished, seated beside the Great Glory.

old: Testament of Reuben 3:1 — *the spirit of fornication is seated in the nature and in the senses.* The heart-architecture preceding the bodily act; Matt 5:28's *whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart* restores the heart-substance the antithesis names.
new: Reuben, Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 3:1 — *an eighth spirit of sleep, with which is brought about the trance of nature and the image of death.* Reuben lists the spirits that work in a man through his nature and his senses, the first of them being fornication — *First, the spirit of fornication is seated in the nature and in the senses* (Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 3:3) — and Yahusha (Jesus) puts the sin in the same place when he says that whoever looks on a woman to lust after her *hath committed adultery with her already in his heart* (Matthew 5:28).

old: Testament of Issachar (DB ch 41 v.8) — *Elohim (God) aided my singleness. For on all the poor and oppressed I bestowed the good things of the earth in the singleness of my heart.* The patriarch's own testimony to the singleness-as-open-handed-bestowal architecture; Matt 6:22's *single eye full of light* walks the same.
new: Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 64:7 — *Jacob, my father, knew that Elohim (God) aided my singleness.* Issachar's single heart is an open hand toward the poor, and Yahusha (Jesus) says, *if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light* (Matthew 6:22).

old: Jubilees 3:29 — *And He sent out of the Garden of Eden all flesh that was in the Garden of Eden, and all flesh was scattered according to its kinds, and according to its types to the places which had been created for them.* The same primeval record of the expulsion that frames the gate-scene of 1-adam-eve 3:10 — one history of the driven-out, kept in both books.
new: Jubilees 3:29 — *And He sent out of the Garden of Eden all flesh that was in the Garden of Eden, and all flesh was scattered according to its kinds, and according to its types to the places which had been created for them.* The same primeval record of the expulsion that frames the gate-scene of 1 Adam and Eve 3:10 — one history of the driven-out, kept in both books.
